nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of NiCo(OH)x
nodes.procedure: Co(NO3)2·6H2O (3 mmol), Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (1.5 mmol), CH4N2O (15.75 mmol), and NH4F (0.06 g) were mixed in 22.5 mL DI water. The solution was added to a 50 mL hydrothermal reactor and then the sealed reactor was placed in a drying oven at 150 °C for 3 h. After the hydrothermal reaction, the produced NiCo(OH)x was washed with a large amount of water and dried at 80 °C for 10 h.

nodes.procedure: The NiCo2O4 was impregnated with NH4F aqueous solution and dried at 80 °C under air for 10 h. Calcination was performed at 200 °C under Argon gas for 2 h to obtain NiCo2O4·Fn.
